description: On the table in front, there’s a white square base with a vertical peg-like post, and a small white rectangular block to the right. The right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the block as a right-hand object, lifts it up and over the base, then lowers and presses it down onto the vertical post while the left hand moves in from the left to steady the base as a left-hand object; the right hand releases once the block is seated.
